description: Synthetic: escrow ids, block hashes, block numbers and indexes are made up. Only the genesis hash is real (faucet GET /chain and tclk/flop/VERIFICATION.md). The page file is written by hand. Escrow a1 has a finalized open whose index is the literal 9007199254740993, which is beyond 2^53 - 1 and is rounded by JSON parsing. An unsafe integer makes the event malformed, so a1 is unverified, not funded. Escrow b2 has a clean finalized open on the same page and stays funded.
